about: v8b: as v7c (the strings Composer's Assistant 2 wrote), the end tidier: from the tune's last note every written part holds its tones of the last chord, dying away with the piano's (held_end; 7c's strings went on with little figures); the strings about 2 dB softer through the last verse (written_swell 0.57 and 0.74 for 0.75 and 1.0: expression's level goes as its square); and one more colour, written by the model over the last refrain hearing the piano and 7c's strings, each as its own instrument: horns (plan colour-horns, take 2 of 3: two horns holding warm chords in the middle, G3-D4 over G, E3-G3 over A7, under the strings' top, nothing against them; take 1 doubled the tune two octaves down).
